title: arenaria marina var. media
intro: Arenaria marina var. media, commonly known as Sea Sandwort or Sea Campions, is a coastal succulent plant that thrives in sandy, saline environments. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sea Sandwort include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of Arenaria marina var. media include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
